messages.snippet: Tom, Before Atlas completes can you make sure the Pennington v Crossfield trial bundle is finalised
messages.subject: Pennington trial bundle - counsel's note
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Before Atlas completes can you make sure the Pennington v Crossfield trial bundle is finalised - Harriet Stanford wants the updated quantum schedule and Dr Iqbal's metallurgy report cross-referenced in the core bundle by Friday. Trial is 9 February so we cannot let it slip while we are heads-down on the deal.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
